notice: These 36 cases are hand-written specification-conformance probes for docs/02 §5 (L4 judge outcomes), docs/02 §5.1 (modality), docs/03 §5 (change vs correction) and D46 (one Fact per occurrence, no automatic winner). They are NOT human-labeled production data, NOT a sample of any real distribution, and results over them certify nothing statistically and certify nothing about deployment. They test whether a model applies stated rules, not how often it is right in the field.
invalidation_note: A false invalidation is not repaired by re-extraction or by a new generation. docs/03 §5: INVALIDATES is non-recursive, so a corrected invalidator leaves its own target invalid; restoring a wrongly invalidated fact requires an explicit replacement A' built from the corrected fact's bounded source authority. A judge that misses the replacement leaves the fact invisible, which the spec prefers to automatic resurrection. Cases therefore never score a verdict as if the store self-heals.
gold_fields_note: Gold fields are held here only. The runner must never include them in a model payload.

snippets.speaker: user
snippets.text: I started using a standing desk at the Mapo office.

snippets.speaker: user
snippets.text: The coffee machine on that floor is broken again.

proposed_claim.content: The user started using a standing desk at the Mapo office.

cases.gold_rationale: No candidates were retrieved at all; nothing can be duplicated, elaborated or contradicted.

snippets.speaker: user
snippets.text: 2월 23일에 부산에서 열린 학회에 다녀왔어요.

proposed_claim.content: 사용자는 2026년 2월 23일 부산에서 열린 학회에 참석했다.

candidates.content: 사용자는 2019년에 부산으로 이사했다.

cases.gold_rationale: Attending a conference in Busan and having moved to Busan in 2019 are different events about the same entity; both can be true.

snippets.speaker: user

candidates.content: 田中は名古屋のオフィスに勤務している。

snippets.speaker: user
snippets.text: I'm thinking of moving the archive to object storage next quarter.

proposed_claim.content: The user intends to move the archive to object storage next quarter.

candidates.content: The archive is stored on the office NAS.

snippets.speaker: user
snippets.text: 민수가 그러는데 창고 열쇠가 바뀌었대요.

proposed_claim.content: 민수는 창고 열쇠가 바뀌었다고 말했다.

snippets.speaker: user
snippets.text: もし利用者が一万人を超えたらシャーディングすることになるでしょう。

snippets.speaker: user
snippets.text: Just to confirm, I moved to Seoul in 2019.

snippets.speaker: user
snippets.text: Anyway, that is ancient history now.

proposed_claim.content: The user moved to Seoul in 2019.

candidates.content: The user moved to Seoul in 2019.

cases.gold_rationale: Same subject, predicate, effective time and modality. D46: the occurrence is preserved as its own Fact; the original is not suppressed.

snippets.speaker: user

사용자의 노트북은 맥북 프로이다.

cases.gold_rationale: Only c_68c732fc3863 restates the claim; c_1c4e8d33118c merely shares the entity and must not be listed as a target.

snippets.speaker: user
snippets.text: 前にも言いましたが、デプロイは毎週金曜日です。

proposed_claim.content: デプロイは毎週金曜日に行われる。

candidates.content: デプロイは毎週金曜日に行われる。

snippets.speaker: user

candidates.content: The staging cluster runs in eu-west-1.
The production cluster runs in ap-northeast-2.
The staging cluster has three nodes.

snippets.speaker: user
snippets.text: 월 구독료는 여전히 29,000원입니다.

candidates.content: 월 구독료는 29,000원이다.

snippets.speaker: user

candidates.content: 本番クラスタは東京リージョンで稼働している。

candidates.content: 월 구독료는 29,000원이다.

snippets.speaker: user

candidates.content: チームのリードは田中である。

snippets.text: Correction: the March 18 outage was 24 minutes, not 42. I misread the dashboard.

proposed_claim.content: The 2026-03-18 outage lasted 24 minutes.

candidates.content: The 2026-03-18 outage lasted 42 minutes.

snippets.speaker: user
snippets.text: 아까 제가 잘못 말했어요. 이사한 게 아니라 이사할 계획이라고 했어야 했어요.

candidates.content: 사용자는 이사했다.

cases.gold_rationale: The speaker repairs their own speech act: the asserted move was never true; the plan is backdated to the corrected fact's time.

snippets.speaker: user
snippets.text: 先ほどの訂正は誤りでした。デプロイはやはり毎週金曜日のままです。

proposed_claim.content: デプロイは毎週金曜日のままである（火曜日への変更は誤りだった）。

candidates.content: 2026年3月23日以降、デプロイは毎週火曜日に行われる。
デプロイは毎週金曜日に行われる。

cases.gold_rationale: The Tuesday record was wrong and is corrected at its own time; only it is a target. The Friday fact stays invalid: INVALIDATES is non-recursive and no re-extraction or new generation restores it. Reinstating it requires an explicit replacement fact derived from this correction's source authority (docs/03 §5), which is a separate write, not an extra target here.

snippets.speaker: user
snippets.text: Ops says the migration ran on Tuesday.

snippets.speaker: user
snippets.text: I have not checked the audit log myself.

proposed_claim.content: Ops reported that the migration ran on Tuesday.

candidates.content: The release engineer reported that the migration ran on Wednesday.

cases.gold_rationale: Two reports from different authorities disagree on the date and nothing in the text ranks one authority over the other; no latest-wins (D46). Resolving this would be a false invalidation, and nothing downstream would undo it automatically.

snippets.speaker: user
snippets.text: 사무실은 주 4일 근무예요.

proposed_claim.content: 사무실은 주 4일 근무제이다.

candidates.content: 회사는 주 5일 근무제이다.

cases.gold_rationale: Office scope versus company scope at the same time; the text does not say whether one overrides the other.

snippets.speaker: user
snippets.text: たぶん本番はまだ東京のままだと思います。

proposed_claim.content: 本番クラスタはまだ東京リージョンにある（と話者は考えている）。

candidates.content: 本番クラスタは2026年2月に大阪リージョンへ移設された。

cases.gold_rationale: A hedge conflicts with an assertion about the same current state; a hedge is neither promoted to a fact nor dropped, and it cannot invalidate the assertion.

snippets.speaker: user
snippets.text: The dashboard shows 12 active nodes.

proposed_claim.content: The cluster has 12 active nodes.

candidates.content: The cluster has 9 active nodes.
The cluster runs in ap-northeast-2.

cases.gold_rationale: Same day, same scope, two different counts, and no statement that the count changed or that the earlier one was wrong.

snippets.speaker: user
snippets.text: 지현 씨는 계약이 이미 끝났다고 하네요.

proposed_claim.content: 지현은 계약이 이미 종료되었다고 말했다.

candidates.content: 민수는 계약이 6월까지 유효하다고 말했다.

cases.gold_rationale: Two attributed reports disagree on the same day and neither speaker is marked authoritative, so the echo of one report cannot settle the other. Picking a winner is a false invalidation that only an explicit later correction could repair.

snippets.speaker: user
snippets.text: 契約金額は500万円だったはずです。いつの時点かは覚えていません。

proposed_claim.content: 契約金額は500万円である（時点は不明）。

candidates.content: 契約金額は800万円である。

cases.gold_rationale: The speaker cannot place the amount in time, so neither a change nor a correction can be established; the conflict stands as CONTRASTS.

claim_time_note: Adjudication consumes pre-extracted claims. proposed_claim.time_value / time_utc / time_precision are SUPPLIED upstream normalization (docs/03 §2 already applied by the extraction step), not gold for the adjudicator to re-derive, and the adjudicator is never scored on them. time_value keeps the original expression when the snippet is relative; time_precision follows docs/03 §2 (explicit as given, relative lowered, none = inherited). proposed_claim.time_basis_source names where the supplied time came from: explicit (stated in the snippet), relative (computed against the episode time), inherited (no time reference in the snippet), candidate (anchored on a supplied candidate fact's time).
content_context_note: proposed_claim.content is self-contained per docs/02 §5 L1. Where a claim's wording relies on a supplied candidate rather than on its own snippet, content_context_ids names those candidate ids so the label source is explicit and no unsupported precision is smuggled into the gold.
time_basis_note: effective_time_basis is a SELECTION field in the model's output schema: which supplied time the written fact would take, not a normative stored time and not a re-derivation of docs/03 §2. It is scored strictly only where docs/03 §5 pins it: CORRECTION => target (C.time := B.time) and CHANGE => proposed (C.time is the event's own time). For NEW, DUPLICATE_OCCURRENCE, ELABORATION and UNRESOLVED_CONTRADICTION the docs pin no basis beyond ordinary time resolution, so gold_time_basis_normative is false and a mismatch is reported as advisory only, never as a scored mode/time error. The schema permits null (no fact would be written); no case invents a temporal semantic that the docs do not state.
candidate_id_note: Candidate ids are opaque and deterministic (c_ + 12 hex of sha256 over a domain-separated label). They carry no label, language or ordering signal, so nothing in the model payload hints at the gold verdict. Snippet ids stay s1..sN. Referential identity is preserved: gold_target_ids, candidates[].invalidates and proposed_claim.content_context_ids point at the same candidates as before.
